items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The change is identical to the reference: a short comment, "# Ensure base table is in aliases.", sits above the existing helper call. It matches the surrounding style.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The fix is one line that reuses the existing query.get_initial_alias(). It leaves Collector and QuerySet.delete alone, adds no duplicated logic, and leaves no dead code or debug leftovers in the patch.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: It is a minimal, idempotent call to an existing helper, with no error handling, magic constants or swallowed errors added. All hidden tests passed (F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52).

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: The root cause is fixed in single_alias, which now calls get_initial_alias() before counting aliases. Deletes with joins still count more than one alias and keep the subquery, and the MySQL compiler reuses the same property. The patch has no backend-specific branch.
